description: This file defines the SearchFragment class for the search UI in an Android notes app, handling search input, navigation, and UI updates.

classes.name: SearchFragment
classes.description: A fragment for searching notes, managing search input, navigation to editor, and UI updates.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the view, sets up search input listener, and handles first load logic.

methods.name: onNoteClick
methods.description: Handles click on a note, navigating to the editor with animation.

methods.name: onNoteLongClick
methods.description: Handles long click on a note, showing a menu.

methods.name: onNotesChanged
methods.description: Updates UI based on the list of notes, showing appropriate indicators.
